title: Steelers visit with QB Taylen Green on Monday

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Steelers visit with QB Taylen Green on Monday
sources.description: The Steelers expect to get word from Aaron Rodgers about his plans for the 2026 season before the draft, but they'll still need to think about the future of the quarterback position if Rodgers does return for a second year in Pittsburgh.
